Ragini: Postmortem follow-up 1: we split the remediation into three cards. Need owners, firm ETAs, and clear acceptance criteria so remediation board can track. Short replies pls.
Ben: I'll claim RM-7812 (kv-cache eviction tuning + telemetry). ETA 4d. Will add perf plan + acceptance criteria by EOD tomorrow.
Omar: Please include a monthly regression job and the dashboard panels. Also add a short note about the recurring 1st-of-month spike.
Ben: Added monthly job + dashboard link. Acceptance: p95 < 85ms on canary, sustained cache hit >92%. ETA Thu-2024-06-13. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RM-7812
Sasha: I'll take RM-7823 (failover orchestration + runbook + dry-run). Creating ticket now.
Sasha: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RM-7823  stub created, estimate 5d. Will add staged-canary steps and rollback toggle.
Diego: RM-7834 (capacity alerts + autoscale knobs) needs eng-infra code change. Eng-infra to own infra change; I'll verify metrics post-deploy.
Ragini: RACI proposal: RM-7812 R=Ben A=Omar C=SRE I=Oncall; RM-7823 R=Sasha A=Ragini C=Platform I=PMs; RM-7834 R=Eng-Infra A=Diego C=Platform I=Customers. OK?
Omar: Works for me. Also please tag with "postmortem-action" and add to the "remediation-board" so PMs/compliance can see status.
incident-bot: Reminder: remediation owners must add a Jira due date and acceptance criteria within 48h.
Ben: RM-7812 updated with perf scripts, dashboard panels, and a recurrence note. Tagged and added to remediation-board.
Sasha: RM-7823 runbook draft uploaded; included rollback steps and a staged-canary checklist. ETA Mon-2024-06-17.
Diego: Eng-infra assigned RM-7834 to Luis. Luis will post an ETA and a short changelog by EOD tomorrow.
Ragini: I'll run 15m weekly triage until these close, then move to monthly audits for 3 months. I'll send invites. If anyone needs a handoff for rollout/dry-run, ping me and I'll pair.
Omar: One more: add a small evaluation task in each ticket that verifies the monthly spike mitigation, and wire the evaluation results to the quality dashboard.
Ben: Added eval task to RM-7812 and a dashboard widget.
Ragini: Thanks all. I'll cross-check ticket tags and RACI on Friday and update PM. :white_check_mark:
